extraFacts.fact: Wave 4 products are API certified and supplied with the API monogram by API-licensed manufacturers to the applicable specification: API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 16D or API 7K.

faqs.q: What is a 4-inch 5,000 psi drilling mud manifold used for?
faqs.a: A drilling mud manifold routes drilling mud between the pumps, standpipe and tanks. This one is engineered to your P&ID, with a 4-inch nominal ID at 5,000 psi MAWP, Demco or Oteco gate valves as standard, and welded construction with X-ray inspection and post weld heat treatment.

faqs.q: What sizes and pressures can the 4-inch 5,000 psi drilling mud manifold be built for?
faqs.a: Sizes from 2 inch to 6 inch and pressures from 3,000 to 15,000 psi are available, and this listing is the 4-inch 5,000 psi version. State the nominal ID and MAWP on the RFQ with your P&ID.

faqs.q: What is the pressure rating basis of the 4-inch 5,000 psi drilling mud manifold?
faqs.a: The rating is 5,000 psi MAWP, the maximum allowable working pressure, for a 4-inch nominal ID. All pressure tests follow API 6A, so the test pressure is higher than the working pressure.

faqs.q: What valves does the 4-inch 5,000 psi drilling mud manifold use?
faqs.a: It uses Demco or Oteco gate valves as standard, selected by the customer. The manifold is welded, with every weld X-rayed and the welded joints post weld heat treated.

faqs.q: What testing and witness comes with the 4-inch 5,000 psi drilling mud manifold?
faqs.a: All pressure tests are conducted per API 6A with third-party witness (BV, DNV or Lloyds), and a complete databook is included. It is supplied as an API-certified, API-monogrammed unit from an API-licensed manufacturer, with the API documentation supplied.

faqs.q: What end connections can the 4-inch 5,000 psi drilling mud manifold have?
faqs.a: End connections are flanged, hammer-union, API clamp hub or Grayloc on request. Match them to the pumps, standpipe and hoses; see [flow iron fittings](/c/flow-iron-fittings-suppliers-uae) and [API flanges](/c/flow-iron-flanges-api).

faqs.q: How does the 4-inch 5,000 psi drilling mud manifold differ from the standpipe manifold?
faqs.a: The mud manifold is engineered to your P&ID with welded construction and X-ray, while the [standpipe manifold](/p/standpipe-manifold-mud) is a rig-specific gathering manifold with union connections at 5,000 and 7,500 psi. Choose by where it sits in the mud circuit.

faqs.q: Where is the 4-inch 5,000 psi drilling mud manifold used?
faqs.a: It is used in the drilling mud circuit between the mud pumps and the standpipe on drilling rigs. See [mud pump packages](/c/dw-mud-pump-package) and the guide on [cementing and drilling-fluid equipment](/blog/cementing-and-drilling-fluid-equipment).

faqs.q: What should I send for a drilling mud manifold quotation?
faqs.a: Send the P&ID, nominal size, MAWP, valve make, end connections, the witness requirement (BV, DNV or Lloyds) and the delivery site. The manifold is engineered to your P&ID.

faqs.q: Why is the 4-inch 5,000 psi drilling mud manifold welded with X-ray and PWHT?
faqs.a: Every weld is X-ray inspected and the welded joints are post weld heat treated, which checks weld quality and relieves stress in a pressure-bearing assembly. The databook records the inspection results.

faqs.q: Can the 4-inch 5,000 psi drilling mud manifold be changed to a different size or pressure?
faqs.a: Yes. The ranges of 2 inch to 6 inch and 3,000 to 15,000 psi are available, and the manifold is built to your P&ID. Send the requirement through [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Does Indus stock the 4-inch 5,000 psi drilling mud manifold?
faqs.a: Yes. We list the 4-inch 5,000 psi drilling mud manifold as ex-stock from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Each manifold is engineered to your P&ID. Send your capacity, configuration and destination through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.

faqs.q: What is a standpipe manifold used for?
faqs.a: A standpipe manifold gathers mud from the pumps and sends it up the standpipe to the top drive and down the drill string. Its valves balance the pumps, divert off-spec mud for treatment and isolate lines for maintenance, so the well gets a steady supply of the right mud.

faqs.q: What sizes and pressures does the 5,000 and 7,500 psi standpipe manifold cover?
faqs.a: The published range is 2-1/16" to 5-1/8" bore at 5,000 and 7,500 psi working pressure. The layout is customised to the rig. Each unit is configured to the job, with the general arrangement drawing and data book index with the quotation.

faqs.q: What material and temperature classes does the 5,000 and 7,500 psi standpipe manifold offer?
faqs.a: The listing gives API 6A material classes DD, EE and FF, temperature classes L to X, and PSL 1 to 4 with PR1 or PR2. Hydrostatic tests follow API 6A / 16A / 16C at the PSL ordered.

faqs.q: What valves does the 5,000 and 7,500 psi standpipe manifold use?
faqs.a: It has manual mud valves with metal-to-metal seals, union-connected piping and monitoring ports for pressure and flow. The union connections are quick and secure to make up.

faqs.q: Is the 5,000 and 7,500 psi standpipe manifold made to API 6A?
faqs.a: Yes. It is built to API 6A and supplied as an API-certified, API-monogrammed unit from an API-licensed manufacturer, with the API certificate and monogram documentation supplied with the order. Material certificates and the pressure-test record are included.

faqs.q: What end connections does the 5,000 and 7,500 psi standpipe manifold have?
faqs.a: End connections are hammer union or flanged. Match them to the pump discharge lines and the standpipe; see [flow iron fittings](/c/flow-iron-fittings-suppliers-uae) and [hammer unions](/c/hammer-unions-sour-gas-service).

faqs.q: How does the 5,000 and 7,500 psi standpipe manifold differ from the 4-inch mud manifold?
faqs.a: The standpipe manifold is a rig-layout manifold at 5,000 and 7,500 psi with manual valves, while the [4-inch 5,000 psi mud manifold](/p/drilling-mud-manifold-4-inch-5-000-psi-demco-valves-x-ray-pwht) is engineered to a client P&ID with X-ray and PWHT welds. See [mud manifolds](/c/dw-mud-manifolds).

faqs.q: Where is the 5,000 and 7,500 psi standpipe manifold used?
faqs.a: It is used for drilling mud and fluid circulation on the rig between the pumps and the top drive. See the guide on [cementing and drilling-fluid equipment](/blog/cementing-and-drilling-fluid-equipment).

faqs.q: What pressure rating should I choose for a standpipe manifold?
faqs.a: Choose 5,000 or 7,500 psi to match the mud pump discharge pressure and the rig rating, and send the pump details on the RFQ. Do not choose a rating below the pump relief setting.

faqs.q: What should I send for a standpipe manifold quotation?
faqs.a: Send the working pressure, bore sizes, end connections, material and temperature class, PSL, the fluids and H2S content and the rig layout. We review the data sheet and flag anything that needs clarifying.

faqs.q: Can the standpipe manifold layout be customised?
faqs.a: Yes, the layout is customised to the rig. Send the rig layout and tie-in positions, and a general arrangement drawing is prepared with the quotation.

faqs.q: Does Indus stock the 5,000 and 7,500 psi standpipe manifold?
faqs.a: Yes. We list the 5,000 and 7,500 psi standpipe manifold as ex-stock from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Most are built to the order specification. Send your capacity, configuration and destination through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
